name: doppel-sdk
description: Doppel SDK monorepo: core client and agent claw

scripts.pack:check: pnpm run build && pnpm publish -r --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public
scripts.docker:build: sh -c 'if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; ref="${GCP_CLAW_DOCKER_IMAGE:-cr3labs/doppel-claw:latest}"; repo="${ref%:*}"; if [ "$repo" != "$ref" ]; then docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64 -t "$ref" -t "${repo}:stage" .; else docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64 -t "$ref" .; fi'
